methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in to the intended Resend team. The full_access grant covers reading and managing account resources, including sending email and deletion. Review the discovered actions in Paperclip before using them.
methods.label: Sign in with Resend
warnings: Resend full_access grants broad account read/write/delete access; Paperclip action policies govern execution separately.
